title: 흉내 내는 말: 반짝반짝, 짝짝
objective: By the end, you can understand ten common Korean sound and shape words, such as 반짝반짝, 짝짝, 깜짝 and 두근두근, and use each one in a short sentence that fits the situation.
summary: Learn ten common Korean sound and shape words (like 반짝반짝 and 짝짝) that make everyday descriptions vivid.

task.title: Use the right sound word
task.line: Read each sentence, think about the sound or movement, and choose, write or check the word that fits.

words.meaning: twinkling; sparkling (light that flashes again and again)
words.exampleMeaning: The stars are twinkling in the night sky.

words.meaning: clap clap (the sound of clapping hands)
with a start; suddenly surprised (used with 놀라다)
words.exampleMeaning: The phone rang suddenly, and it startled me.

words.meaning: thump thump (heavy steps or bumps on the floor)
words.exampleMeaning: I can hear someone running and thumping upstairs.
The child is spinning round and round in one spot.

words.meaning: pounding (a heartbeat when you are nervous or excited); often 두근두근하다
words.exampleMeaning: My heart is pounding because the interview is about to start.

words.meaning: sound asleep (the sound of deep sleeping)
words.exampleMeaning: My younger sibling is fast asleep on the sofa.
It has been pouring since this morning.

words.meaning: yum yum (the sound of eating happily)
words.exampleMeaning: The child is eating bread, yum yum.
I cried my eyes out watching that movie.

exercises: Choose the right word: 고백하기 전에 가슴이 (두근두근 / 빙글빙글)했어요.
Fill in the blank with a word from the list: 새 구두를 닦았더니 ____ 빛나요.
Fill in the blanks with the right sound word: ① 옆집 아이들이 뛰어서 바닥에서 ____ 소리가 나요. ② 우산이 없는데 비가 ____ 와요. ③ 점심시간에 아이가 빵을 ____ 먹어요.
Fill in the blank: 친구가 뒤에서 갑자기 불러서 ____ 놀랐어요.
Is the word used correctly? Write Yes or No: ① 피곤해서 버스에서 쿨쿨 잤어요. ② 크리스마스트리 불빛이 짝짝 빛나요. ③ 놀이 기구를 타고 나서 세상이 빙글빙글 돌아요. ④ 공항에서 친구와 헤어질 때 펑펑 울었어요. ⑤ 공연이 끝나고 손뼉을 깜짝 쳤어요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 쳐 주세요 / 짝짝 / 손뼉을
answers: ① 쿵쿵 ② 주룩주룩 ③ 냠냠
① Yes ② No (반짝반짝) ③ Yes ④ Yes ⑤ No (짝짝)
손뼉을 짝짝 쳐 주세요. (짝짝 손뼉을 쳐 주세요.)
